title: COSI — Maintenance Measurement Payload
description: Payload for maintenance-measurement messages (assetClass=maintenance-measurement). Carries a measured value against upper/lower limits with fault classification and a required document-reference object whose fields may be null.

MeasuredValue.description: A measurement with its unit of measure.

LimitValue.description: A tolerance limit. value and uom are null when the limit is not defined.

componentId.description: Unique identifier of the component being measured.

componentName.description: Human-readable component name including location (e.g., 'SF1 Pressure Roll — Drive-Side Bearing').

measuredValue.description: Value observed at the original envelope timestamp. This message reports an observation, not an open/update/clear fault lifecycle.

upperLimit.description: Upper tolerance bound. Null value when no upper limit is defined.

lowerLimit.description: Lower tolerance bound. Null value when no lower limit is defined.

faultCode.description: Failure mode code from docs/corrugated-faults.md (closed set for v1.0). Null when the measurement is within limits.

descLocalLang.description: Fault description in the local plant language.

severity.description: info = minor, no production loss. warning = operator attention required. critical = immediate action / auto-stop.

uniqueRef.description: Reference to the maintenance manual document. Null if none available.

documentLink.description: URI or file-system path. Null if none available.

documentRef.description: Required document-reference object; its fields may be null when no link is available. Access remains subject to the IT/OT boundary rules.
